connectionSpecification.description: Reads raw events, user profiles, cohorts and their members, annotations, funnels and revenue of one Mixpanel project.

attribution_window.description: Days before the saved cursor an incremental read of export, funnels and revenue starts again, since Mixpanel keeps accepting late events for recent days.
attribution_window.title: Attribution Window

credentials.description: A service account of the organization (recommended), or the legacy API secret of the project.

project_id.description: ID of the project to read (Project settings > Overview). The service account must be a member of it.
project_id.title: Project ID

username.description: Username of the service account (Organization settings > Service accounts).
username.title: Username

api_secret.description: API secret of the project (Project settings > Overview). Mixpanel deprecates project secrets in favour of service accounts.
api_secret.title: Project Secret

credentials.title: Authentication

date_window_size.description: Days requested at a time from the date-ranged endpoints. Smaller windows checkpoint more often but spend more of the hourly request limit.
date_window_size.title: Date Window Size

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, that is read; empty reads up to today in the project time zone.
end_date.title: End Date

page_size.description: Profiles per request of engage and cohort_members, at most 1000.
page_size.title: Profiles Page Size

project_timezone.description: Time zone of the project (Project settings > Overview), as an IANA name. Mixpanel reads from_date and to_date as days of this zone.
project_timezone.title: Project Timezone

region.description: Data residency of the project: US (mixpanel.com, data.mixpanel.com) or EU (eu.mixpanel.com, data-eu.mixpanel.com).
region.title: Region

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose events, funnels, revenue and annotations are read; empty reads from a year before today.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: Mixpanel Source Spec
